postgres._comment: Needed for Phase 3 (schema inspection, migration verification) and Phase 0a derived-mode DB-schema extraction (v2). Replace the connection string with the project's actual dev DB URL, or move it to an env var before committing.

github._comment: Needed for Phase 0a derived mode (reading an existing repo to extract) and for Phase 5 handoff if the deployed project's repo lives on GitHub. Set GITHUB_TOKEN in your shell env, do not hardcode it here.

filesystem._comment: Scoped filesystem access for the generated project directory, useful once Formento starts writing actual app code in Phases 2-5.
